question: Which of the following is a medium - sized globular protein that acts as a pancreatic serine protease found in the digestive system of many vertebrates?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Trypsin**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The medium-sized globular protein you're referring to is **trypsin**
 
• **Trypsin is a pancreatic serine protease**, meaning it belongs to the class of enzymes that cleave peptide bonds in proteins. 
 
• It is f**ound in the digestive systems** of many vertebrates and plays a crucial role in protein digestion by breaking down proteins into smaller peptides
 
• It is **produced in the pancreas** as an inactive precursor, trypsinogen, which is activated in the small intestine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Amylase**

 
 
• It Breaks down starch into sugars (maltose and dextrin) during digestion.
 
• **It is ** Found in saliva (salivary amylase) and pancreas (pancreatic amylase).
 
• **It **Begins working in the mouth and continues in the small intestine.
 
• **It is** Vital for carbohydrate digestion and energy production.
 
 
 
• **Lipase**
 
 
• It Breaks down fats (lipids) into fatty acids and glycerol.
 
• It is produced in Pancreas (pancreatic lipase) and also in smaller amounts in the stomach.
 
• It Primarily acts in the small intestine.
 
• It is Essential for fat digestion and absorption of fat-soluble vitamins.
 
 
 
• **Pepsin**
 
 
• **It **Breaks down proteins into smaller peptides (proteolysis).
 
• **It is produced in **Stomach cells as an inactive precursor, pepsinogen, which is activated by stomach acid.
 
• **It** Works in the acidic environment of the stomach.
 
• **It is **Critical for initiating protein digestion in the stomach.
